description: Inside function call arguments, newlines around the double colon of a function name are ignored
notes: The spec's function call grammar has a single identifier as the function name (FunctionCall = Identifier "(" arguments ")"), and :: is not one of its tokens. hashicorp/hcl accepts names separated by :: and reports them joined with :: as the function name (finishParsingFunctionCall in hclsyntax/parser.go).
